self.title: Can Machines Learn to Ask Better Questions?

detail.title: Can Machines Learn to Ask Better Questions?
detail.lede: We are teaching AI to seek information, but are we teaching it to wonder?
detail.reason: This is a fundamental shift in the project's direction, moving from investigating *if* curiosity is possible to identifying *why* current methods are limited to goal-seeking rather than question-generation.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity
detail.question: Can a system learn to ask better questions instead of only getting better at answering them?
detail.reason: Synthesis of active-learning metrics is underway; moving to formal provisional notebook creation.

children.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity: From Psychology to Artificial Systems

detail.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity: From Psychology to Artificial Systems
detail.summary: Curiosity in AI can be modeled as an information-gain mechanism, but recent research suggests it also acts as a coordination mechanism in multi-agent systems, where 'curiosity' calibrates exploration in sparse-reward environments.
detail.reason: Updates the existing notebook to incorporate newly collected research on multi-agent curiosity mechanisms.
